messages:
Asha: morning async — quick notes: landed kernel prefetch patch on canary, saw ~6% tail latency reduction on small-seq tests. planning to roll to 2/5 canaries tonight.
Tom: nice. did you push the config for the batch slotting change?
Asha: yep, PR #4128 merged. config snippet: ```
batch.slot_size=64
batch.timeout_ms=12
``` (applied to canary)
Priya: saw a memory blip on a long-seq repro earlier; dropping logs in infra bucket: gs://redwood-kv/logs/prefetch-0326.log
Jules: looking now. quick thought — is eviction policy still default LRU? might be thrashing when prefetch + long seqs overlap.
Priya: eviction=segmented_lru on canary, but prefetch warms same hotset as active requests. suspect key-size skew + prefetch overlap.
Tom: can you paste the LC logs? pinging @eng-sre for infra noise / correlation.
ci-bot: Build #4128 passed — canary deploy queued.
Asha: blocker: can't reproduce the mem spike locally — need a trace from the prod canary when sequence length > 8k. @Jules can you add more KV telemetry (cache hit distribution + key sizes)?
Jules: will add histograms. plan: per-shard hit histo, 99th key-size bucket, and a runtime flag to disable aggressive prefetch for sequences > 4k.
Priya: that flag sounds good. for perf bench, yesterday's microbench shows qps @1k-seq down ~4% but p99 improved. results in bench/2026-03-16-prefetch.csv (link).
Tom: code review: left comments on PR #4133 (batcher fairness). small nit on slot ordering; otherwise LGTM.
Asha: FYI before we roll remaining canaries — enabling fallback to smaller quantized model when backlog spikes. rollout config in the rollout plan doc.
Jules: question — what's the metric threshold for fallback? latency p99 > 800ms sustained for >30s?
Asha: that's the current threshold. we can iterate after more data.
Priya: today's tasks: reproduce mem blowup, add histos, patch prefetch flag + unit tests, re-run microbench.
Tom: i'll pick up the review and run perf later today.
ci-bot: Canary deploy 2/5 complete. No OOMs observed so far.
Asha: thanks team. i'll post a short summary in eng-runtime later. anything else?
Tom: none from me. :thumbsup:
Jules: adding todos to the sprint board.
Priya: +1. tagging this thread for follow-up. /end
